_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Rocker/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, one cell, the controller [0,0,0]: the box runs along x, its head (the hopper) east and its open foot west; the operator stands at the handle on the north side, and a ppex pipe comes in on the south face. A hand station: no power cell. theta is the rocking, the hold-to-work clock: one turn is one rock (over to the south and back over to the north). Points with a part ride it. See the rocker's README for the schema.

rock._comment: As drawn: the cradle rocks degrees each way, degrees sin(theta), one rock a turn of theta; its rockers' running faces have this radius (blocks) and roll on the sills, so it also slides south by radius times the angle. It is level at theta 0 and pi: a renderer that stops runs theta on to the next of those.
